description: Create a recurring task. It generates task instances on a schedule, each with the reminders set in reminderOffsetMinutes.

items.description: Member ids round-robined one per instance. Ids that are no longer members are skipped, leaving that instance unassigned.

cronExpression.description: Interval as 'N Unit', Unit one of Day, Week, Month, Year, e.g. '2 Week'. Not cron syntax.

endDate.description: Inclusive last date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for open-ended.

isUrgent.description: Mark every task this series generates as urgent.

maxOccurrences.description: Cap on instances generated, applied even if endDate is not reached.

notes.description: Notes copied to every generated instance.

preparationDays.description: Legacy single reminder, days before each occurrence's due date, 0-365 (0 means none); use reminderOffsetMinutes instead. Ignored when reminderOffsetMinutes is sent.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: Reminder lead times, in minutes before each generated task's due date. Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 40320 (4 weeks, the most for a repeating item); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. A due date counts from 00:00 on that day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before, or up to 15 minutes earlier.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

startDate.description: First date to generate from, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

title.description: Title given to every generated instance.

name: create_recurring_task
